messages:
incident-bot: Incident created: HIGH - tokenizer preproc CPU OOMs causing pod restarts in prod-eu.
Aisha (oncall): paging via pagerduty — multiple tokenizer pods killed, start times ~12:05 UTC. Seeing kernel OOM messages on node gke-eu-13.
Ben (eng-sre): on it. can you post `kubectl get pods -n redwood-serving | grep tokenizer` output? also any logs from /var/log/kern.log?
Aisha (oncall): copied logs: 
```
Apr 12 12:04:58 gke-eu-13 kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 13245 (tokenizer) total-vm:215000kB, anon-rss:98000kB
Apr 12 12:04:58 gke-eu-13 kernel: oom_reaper: reaped process 13245 (tokenizer)
```
Aisha (oncall): pod crashloop backoff + node pressure looks correlated with heavy prompt burst from internal customer-batch job.
Carlos (eng-runtime): possibly the preproc loop doesn't cap extremely long prompts — we've seen pathological backtracking when whitespace regexes hit 10k tokens.
Maya (support): Customer X reported 504s at 12:03 UTC — looks like about 30s error window, spike in requests from a single API key.
Ben (eng-sre): immediate mitigations: 1) cordon node gke-eu-13 2) scale tokenizer deployment to 0.5x (reduce concurrency) 3) temp rate-limit offending API key via gateway
Aisha (oncall): doing step 1 and 2 now. `kubectl cordon gke-eu-13` -> done. patching HPA/replicas to 2 -> applied.
Aisha (oncall): applying API key block in gateway: `redwood-gwctl block-key --key pk_live_*** --reason "tokenizer storm"`
incident-bot: automated update: 2 pods evicted, 3 pods restarting. Alerts suppressed for 10m.
Carlos (eng-runtime): suggestion: hotpatch tokenizer config to add prompt length cap and change tokenization strategy to streaming tokenizer. I'll prepare a small configmap patch.
Ben (eng-sre): while Carlos prepares patch, let's add a mutating webhook to reject >5k token requests — quick stopgap.
Maya (support): I notified Customer X and a second customer Z about throttling and suggested retry window. Support ticket created: INC-9876.
Carlos (eng-runtime): patch ready. command:
```
kubectl -n redwood-serving set env deployment/tokenizer MAX_TOKENS=5000
kubectl rollout restart deployment/tokenizer
```
Aisha (oncall): applied MAX_TOKENS=5000 and restarted. pods are coming up, CPU usage trending down.
Ben (eng-sre): also saw a CUDA error from a different pod earlier but that's unrelated — GPU pool unaffected. I'll file follow-up.
Maya (support): Customer X confirmed 504s stopped after 12:12 UTC. They lost ~7 requests; flagged for SLO credit.
incident-bot: incident severity updated to MEDIUM — partial customer impact confirmed.
Ben (eng-sre): preparing postmortem notes. root cause: unbounded prompt processing in tokenizer preproc loop + bursty client causing CPU OOM -> pod kill -> upstream 504s. Immediate fix: rate-limit offending key + MAX_TOKENS cap. Mid-term: streaming tokenizers + per-client concurrency limits.
Aisha (oncall): handing off to Ben for postmortem and followups — I'm heading OOTO in 15m. @ben please take the incident.
Ben (eng-sre): ack. taking over. I'll coordinate retro, follow-ups: 1) blacklist/auto-throttle logic in gateway 2) add runtime guardrails in tokenizer 3) deploy node-level oom-score adjustments 4) add alert for tokenization hotloops.
Maya (support): I'll keep customers updated and coordinate SLO credit with finance.
deploy-bot: Reminder: next deploy window 18:00 UTC — please avoid rolling restarts for >10m post-mitigation.
Ben (eng-sre): logging final state: all tokenizer pods stable on new config, CPU usage normalized, affected node gke-eu-13 remained cordoned for analysis.
Aisha (oncall): thanks team — closing active paging. will join retro async.
Maya (support): adding incident notes to ticket INC-9876.
incident-bot: Incident resolved: TIME TO RESOLVE 00:28:19. postmortem owner assigned: Ben.
